title: The fixed tick and input checks
hints: Work in whole microseconds: `accumulator / step` is the number of whole steps and `accumulator % step` (or subtracting them) leaves the remainder, with no rounding error building up.
Compare the length with 1 before dividing, and check `std::isfinite` first: the length of a vector with an infinite part is infinite, and dividing by it gives NaN.
